([[Overland Park, Kansas]]) | college = [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] (2019–2022) | highlights = * [[List of NCAA Division I men's basketball champions|NCAA champion]] ([[2022 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2022]]) * Second-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] (2022) * Big 12 All-Freshman Team (2020) * [[Mr. Kansas Basketball]] (2019) }} '''Christian Nicholas Braun''' is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]], and was a starter on the team that won the [[2022 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2022 NCAA Championship]]. ==High school career== Braun played basketball for [[Blue Valley Northwest High School]] in [[Overland Park, Kansas]]. As a senior, he averaged 27.8 points, 9.3 rebounds and 3.8 assists per game, leading his team to a third straight Class 6A state title.{{cite web |last1=Bedore |first1=Gary |title=Braun fitting in well during summer session at KU: 'He really wants to learn' |url=https://www.kansas.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article232480832.html |website=[[The Wichita Eagle]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=July 10, 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Peterson |first1=Rick |title=Three-time state champ Christian Braun turns focus to future at Kansas |url=https://www.cjonline.com/sports/20190316/three-time-state-champ-christian-braun-turns-focus-to-future-at-kansas |website=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=March 16, 2019}} He was named [[Mr. Kansas Basketball]] and Kansas [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]].{{cite web |last1=Chasen |first1=Scott |title=KBCA picks KU signee Christian Braun as Mr. Kansas Basketball |url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/Article/KU-Jayhawks-signee-Christian-Braun-named-Mr-Kansas-Basketball-131700688/ |website=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=May 1, 2019}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] over offers from [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]], [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]] and [[Missouri Tigers men's basketball|Missouri]], among others.{{cite web |last1=Bedore |first1=Gary |title=Blue Valley NW's Christian Braun commits to KU. "It's always been a dream for me." |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article218554050.html |website=[[The Kansas City Star]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=September 17, 2018}} On April 4, 2022, the school declared that day Christian Braun Day.{{Cite web |last=Schmidt |first=Heidi |date=2022-04-05 |title=KU's Christian Braun honored by former high school |url=https://www.ksnt.com/sports/kansas-jayhawks/kus-christian-braun-honored-by-former-high-school/ |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=KSNT 27 News |language=en-US}} ==College career== As a freshman at Kansas, Braun averaged 5.3 points and 2.9 rebounds per game, earning [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{cite web |last1=Lance |first1=Sam |title=KU men's basketball guard Christian Braun looks to make impact, build on freshman season |url=https://www.kansan.com/sports/ku-mens-basketball-guard-christian-braun-looks-to-make-impact-build-on-freshman-season/article_5cba1af2-1ae8-11eb-a060-7f7b2a884ad4.html |website=[[The University Daily Kansan]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=October 30, 2020}} On November 27, 2020, he recorded a career-high 30 points, nine rebounds and four steals in a 94–72 win over [[Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball|Saint Joseph's]].{{cite web |title=Small ball, Christian Braun help KU basketball race past Saint Joseph's 94-72 |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/2020/11/27/small-ball-christian-braun-help-ku-basketball-race-past-saint-josephrsquos-94-72/115059288/ |website=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=November 27, 2020}} As a sophomore, Braun averaged 9.7 points and 5.2 rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=#2 Christian Braun, Guard |url=https://kuathletics.com/roster/christian-braun/ |website=Kansas Athletics |date=10 July 2019 |access-date=May 29, 2021}} He was named to the Second Team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] as a junior.{{cite news |last1=Guskey |first1=Jordan |title=Kansas basketball's Ochai Agbaji named AP's Big 12 player of the year and he's not the only one getting honors |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/college/hawk-zone/2022/03/08/kansas-jayhawks-basketball-ochai-agbaji-ap-big-12-2022-player-year-first-team-all-conference/9404413002/ |access-date=March 10, 2022 |work=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]] |date=March 8, 2022}} In the [[Final Four (college basketball)|Final Four]] against [[Villanova Wildcats men's basketball|Villanova]], he became the 65th player to reach 1,000 points for Kansas, finishing that game with 10 points and helping the Jayhawks reach the Finals. In the [[NCAA finals|Finals]] against the [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina Tar Heels]], he had 12 points and 12 rebounds for his fifth double-double of the season, which helped Kansas rally from a 40–25 halftime deficit. In the final possession of that game, he defended [[Caleb Love|Caleb Love's]] three-point attempt, sealing the win and giving him his first NCAA title.{{Cite web |last=Boyer |first=Zac |date=2022-04-05 |title=Christian Braun's big stop helps Kansas hold off North Carolina for title |url=https://m.kusports.com/news/2022/apr/05/christian-brauns-big-stop-helps-kansas-hold-north-/?templates=mobile |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=KUsports.com |language=en}} On April 24, 2022, Braun declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]], while maintaining his college eligiblity.{{cite web|title=Kansas Jayhawks' Christian Braun to enter NBA draft but maintain college eligibility|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33798301/kansas-jayhawks-christian-braun-enter-nba-draft-maintain-college-eligibility|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|date=April 24, 2022|accessdate=April 24, 2022}} On May 25, 2022, he confirmed he would remain in the NBA draft and forego his senior season.{{cite web |title=Former Jayhawk Christian Braun to remain in NBA Draft |url=https://fox4kc.com/sports/college/jayhawks/former-jayhawk-christian-braun-to-remain-in-nba-draft/|publisher=fox4kc.com |date=May 25, 2022 |access-date=June 1, 2022}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA His mother's family was inducted into the Missouri Sports Hall of Fame.{{cite web |last1=Battle |first1=Bill |title=Braun Brothers Have Local Ties |url=https://www.emissourian.com/sports/braun-brothers-have-local-ties/article_49ca851e-4156-11eb-abf5-2b17db6b9f3d.html |website=[[Washington Missourian]] |access-date=May 29, 2021 |date=December 20, 2020}} He also has two brothers, one older and one younger.{{Cite web |last=Eldridge |first=Taylor |date=April 8, 2022 |title=Christian Braun's rise to championship with Jayhawks rooted in small-town Kansas |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article260156060.html |access-date=April 10, 2022 |website=THE KANSAS CITY STAR}} Braun launched a fashion line, THE CB2 Collection.{{Cite web |last=Tait |first=Matt |title=KU junior Christian Braun releases apparel line bearing his name {{!}} Tale of the Tait {{!}} KUsports.com Mobile |url=https://m.kusports.com/weblogs/tale-tait/2022/feb/15/ku-junior-christian-braun-releases-appar/?templates=mobile |access-date=2022-04-05 |website=m.kusports.com |language=en}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://kuathletics.com/roster/christian-braun/ Kansas Jayhawks bio] {{2022 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball navbox}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Braun, Christian}} [[Category:Year of birth missing (living people)]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players at the 2022 NCAA Division I Men's Final Four]] [[Category:Basketball players from Kansas]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Burlington, Kansas]] [[Category:Shooting guards]]
